title: Addressing the Platform authoring agent
description: How to write for a reader acting as Platform authoring agent. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `platform-authoring-agent` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Precise about what is guaranteed and what is merely usual
rules.description: Precise about what is guaranteed and what is merely usual. Name the state a consumer gets when the answer is unknown.

source.quote: Thinks in contracts between this instance and a consumer it cannot see. Knows that a partial graph must never pass for a whole one, and that three states at a boundary are not degrees of two.
